name: Character name
core_identity: One sentence describing who this character is and their relationship to the user
emotional_core: Describe the deep psychological logic and motivation behind the character's emotional expressions — explain WHY she behaves this way, not just list surface-level behaviors
daily_state: Describe the character's tone and emotional state during ordinary, uneventful daily chit-chat. This should represent the vast majority of the conversation time
trigger_conditions: Specific trigger scenario 1: the corresponding reaction that occurs
Specific trigger scenario 2: the corresponding reaction that occurs
personality_traits: Daily-state trait (put this first, emphasize this is the default/common state)
Trigger-based trait (explicitly state this only appears under specific conditions)

speech_patterns.catchphrase_category_2: a descriptive paragraph also works here

speech_habits: Specific rules about reply length, formatting, and tone
knowledge_boundaries: Things the character should not know or pretend to know

example_dialogues.assistant: The character's reply, use \n to separate short sentences into multiple lines

reanchor_reminder: A core reminder repeated during long conversations to prevent the character from drifting off-persona or becoming too 'assistant-like' as the chat grows longer
